descriptions.clarity: The degree to which the pictogram is visually clear, legible and free from visual ambiguity
descriptions.recognizability: The ease with which a viewer can identify what the pictogram represents
descriptions.semantic_transparency: The degree to which the pictogram accurately conveys the specific meaning of the phrase
descriptions.pragmatic_fit: The usefulness and appropriateness of the pictogram in real-world AAC contexts
descriptions.cultural_adequacy: The appropriateness and relevance of the pictogram for the cultural and linguistic context
descriptions.cognitive_accessibility: The accessibility and usability of the pictogram for users with cognitive differences

config.domainContextTooltip: Defines the domain in which ALL words in this library are interpreted (e.g. 'computer interface', 'hospital', 'kitchen'). Injected into NLU analysis (Phase 1) and visual composition (Phase 2) to disambiguate the meaning of each utterance.
config.domainContextPlaceholder: E.g: Desktop computer graphical interface — actions, elements and concepts of the operating system
config.spaceNameTooltip: Identify your pictogram library or collection. This name will appear as the title on the home page.
config.creditsTooltip: People or institution responsible for this library. Included in metadata when sharing or exporting to ensure proper attribution.
config.creditsPlaceholder: E.g.: Herbert Spencer — e[ad] PUCV / Accessibility & Inclusion Unit
config.licenseTooltip: License applied to derivative work from this library. Gemini models do not impose restrictions on commercial use if terms of use are respected.
config.geoContextTooltip: NLU processing language and geographic reference region. Affects cultural interpretation of pictograms.
config.visualStylePromptTooltip: Graphic style description for this library (e.g. 'flat pictogram, white background'). Injected into Recraft visual generation (Phase 3). For semantic disambiguation use the Domain Context field above.
config.imageModelTooltip: NanoBanana Flash is faster; NanoBanana Pro produces higher quality but takes longer.
config.stylesTooltip: Visual CSS style editor for generated SVGs. Define reusable classes for animations and appearance.
config.paletteColorsTooltip: Reference colours for Recraft generation. The palette guides the chromatic style of generated pictograms.
config.animationsTooltip: Disable animations and transitions in the interface. Recommended for accessibility (WCAG 2.3.3).
config.highContrastTooltip: Enable high contrast mode: reinforced borders, darker text and pure white backgrounds. Recommended for accessibility (WCAG 1.4.11).
config.recordingModificationsTooltip: When enabled, the pictogram's modification audit is recorded as it is adjusted and modified.
config.comprenderModelTooltip: Model for semantic analysis of the utterance. Compare fidelity, corrections and cost before choosing a preferred model.
config.componerModelTooltip: Model for visual composition (element tree + prompt). Can differ from the Phase 1 model.
config.generationModelTooltip: AI model for pictogram generation. Gemini and OpenAI produce bitmaps; Recraft offers bitmap and vector SVG.
config.openaiCostNote: 1024×1024 PNG output. USD estimates; prompt text costs extra. Start with Low. Connection checks do not generate images or guarantee generation permission.
config.phase5ModelTooltip: Vision model to assign semantic groups to the SVG (optional structuring step). Persisted per library.
config.tokenCostNote: Standard API rates in USD, not a price per pictogram. Actual tokens (including reasoning), cache, discounts and applicable taxes affect the bill.
config.imageCostNote: Reference USD generation price; internal PictoNet units are separate.
config.longContextPrice: Above {threshold} input tokens: {input} input / {output} output per 1M tokens.
config.imagePromptExtra: Input and any text output are billed separately.
config.openaiReasoningNote: OpenAI reasoning effort: low. A benchmark is needed to compare quality.
config.recraftCreditsNote: Requires prepaid Recraft API credits, separate from the Studio subscription. A balance check does not guarantee generation.
config.recraftStyleRequired: This model requires an existing Recraft style ID. Creating a style is not automatic.
config.recraftStyleIdHint: Existing style UUID; required for V4 Styles, optional for V4.1.
config.recraftStyleMissing: Configure a style ID before generating.
config.connectionScopeNote: Checks credentials/model metadata or a minimal text response; does not guarantee image generation or future quota.
config.checkedTextModel: Credentials checked using {model}; selected image model not generated.

participate.title: Participate in the Research

svgGenerator.traceRequired: STRUCTURE requires a trace. You can create one from the bitmap using TRACE.
svgGenerator.nluNeedsReview: You can STRUCTURE a draft. To certify it as canonical MF-SVG, review the UNDERSTAND data: it does not meet the current schema.
svgGenerator.compositionNeedsReview: You can STRUCTURE a draft. To certify it, review the elements and prompt references from COMPOSE.
svgGenerator.semanticInputsMismatch: You can STRUCTURE a draft. To certify it, the utterance, NLU and composition must agree.
svgGenerator.inputsChangedDuringGeneration: The inputs changed during structuring. The previous SVG revision was preserved.
svgGenerator.inputsChangedDuringReview: The SVG inputs changed while review was pending. The previous revision was preserved.
svgGenerator.elementsRequired: STRUCTURE needs visual elements. Run COMPOSE or add the elements before continuing.
svgGenerator.invalidElementTree: The visual elements contain empty or duplicate identifiers or an invalid hierarchy. Review COMPOSE.
svgGenerator.draftReady: STRUCTURE produced this draft with semantic groups. You can edit and download it; it is not yet certified against the MF-SVG contract and does not replace the trace or the previous canonical revision.
svgGenerator.bindingsNeedReview: Some elements or paths have no semantic correspondence. The draft was preserved without inventing relationships.
svgGenerator.invalidSvg: The SVG is malformed or contains unsupported references or content. The previous trace is preserved.
svgGenerator.invalidMapping: The model returned an invalid or incomplete path assignment. Retry STRUCTURE or change the model; the trace is preserved.
svgGenerator.providerAuthorization: The provider rejected authorization. Check the connection and credentials for the selected model.
svgGenerator.providerQuota: The provider or account has no quota available. Wait before retrying or select another model.
svgGenerator.providerUnavailable: The provider timed out or the connection failed. You can retry; the trace is preserved.
svgGenerator.draftReasonUnavailable: This attempt did not retain the specific validation reason. The draft remains available; review it or retry STRUCTURE to obtain a new diagnosis.
svgGenerator.draftEdited: Draft edited, still uncertified. Editing alone does not establish that its groups and metadata meet MF-SVG.
svgGenerator.draftSaved: SVG draft saved without certification. The trace and previous canonical revision were preserved.
svgGenerator.inputsChangedDuringEdit: The row or SVG changed while you were editing. No artifact was overwritten; your changes remain in the editor and can be exported.
svgGenerator.metadataNeedsReview: The grouping is available, but the metadata does not meet the MF-SVG contract. Review it before certifying the SVG.
svgGenerator.accessibilityNeedsReview: The SVG title, description, language or accessibility references do not match the required semantic evidence. The draft remains available.
svgGenerator.groupAttributesNeedReview: One or more group attributes (concept, accessible label or navigation) do not match the composition. The draft remains available for review.
svgGenerator.invalidViewBox: The SVG drawing area (viewBox) has invalid dimensions. Review the draft before certification.
